versions.changelog: v3.3.18: add Quick Start Combo Menu - when user asks what the skill can do, AI proactively presents all 10 Combos with trigger phrases and function descriptions in Chinese

v3.3.17: fix Combo 9 Meme Hunter - Step 1 correct response path (data.tokens), fix field names (percentChange/volume/score), Step 2 expand meme keywords + hours=48, Step 3 use keyword field instead of token_symbol, Step 4 fix jq array syntax~

v3.3.16: fix Combo 8 - Step 1 correct field names (mention_count/top_kols), Step 2 correct field names (keyword/kol_count), Step 3 expand sector keywords to 11 categories, Step 4 fix Smart Money Inflow API path
v3.3.15: fix Combo 7 Step 2/3/4 - correct Binance Smart Money Signal API params (chainId+smartSignalType), fix Inflow API path (tracker/wallet), fix Top Trader PnL API path (market/leaderboard)
v3.3.14: Combo 6 - Step 1 hours=48&limit=500 for full coverage, Step 2 launch/unlock keyword requires crypto context to avoid false positives
v3.3.13: Combo 5 Step 3c - add price_change_24h and kol_count to Binance Social Hype output
v3.3.12: restore Binance Social Hype API with correct required params (targetLanguage, timeRange, sentiment); add geo-restriction note for local environments
v3.3.11: replace Binance Social Hype API (private, param changed) with CoinGecko Trending API in Combo 5 Step 3c
v3.3.10: Combo 4 Security Alert - keyword grouping to reduce geopolitical false positives, signals hours=1, structured 5-section Chinese synthesis prompt
v3.3.7: Combo 2 - trim major coin filter to BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/BNB/USDC/USDT/ADA/LTC; Step 2 uses signal token; Step 6 multi-chain (Solana/BSC/ETH/Base/Arbitrum)
v3.3.6: Redesign Combo 2 - filter major coins, fix all 6 steps logic, add KOL quality scoring, news with links+translation, on-chain cross-reference
v3.3.5: Combo 1.5 method A - merge verification columns into single emoji column (⚡=KOL signal, 🔥=Binance on-chain, 📰=news); add Binance链上独家 section; fix Source B/C/D field descriptions
v3.3.4: Fix Combo 1.5 Step 5 Binance unified rank field (rankList→tokens), update key fields to percentChange24h/volume24h/price, fix Synthesis prompt Source E description
v3.3.3: Fix Combo 1 Step 5 Smart Money endpoint (token/inflow/rank/query→wallet/web/signal/smart-money), fix price/summary key names (BTC→bitcoin), update Synthesis prompt Source F description
v3.3.2: Fix Binance Web3 API endpoints (bnbchain.org → web3.binance.com/bapi/defi/v1/public/wallet-direct)

v3.2.16: Combo 5 Narrative Tracker upgrade - expand keywords (agent/AI split, +Solana/stablecoin/DeFi/NFT), limit 100→3000 (~23h coverage), add Binance spot volume validation (Step 3b), rewrite Synthesis Prompt with Volume Signal column (🔥Surge/📢Active/🔇Quiet) and three-layer signal interpretation
v3.2.15: Add source attribution to Key News/Notable Alpha ([source] format from info/feed); merge DCA reference signal into Combo 1 (BTC dominance axis); remove Combo 5; renumber Combo 6-9 to 5-8

v3.2.14: Replace CoinGecko with Binance+DexScreener for price data; fix /brief/generate date showing wrong year; add price_usd/change_24h fields to /price/trending; remove Combo 4, renumber Combos 5-10 to 4-9
v3.2.11: Add 3-level price fallback chain (CoinGecko→Binance→DexScreener) for /price/token endpoint; new fields: source, chain, dex, pair_address

v3.2.5: Add Combo 1.5 Trending Token Discovery with 4-step multi-factor analysis (KOL mentions x CoinGecko rank x price x news), fix sorting to mention_count desc, add relative strength vs BTC baseline, add news coverage column, add risk warnings for -50% crash and zero-KOL CG hot tokens
v3.2.4: Add language detection rule (full report in user language), change Trending Tokens to Markdown table format, fix [objectObject] rendering issue
v3.2.2: Fix JOIN condition bug (mention_count/signals now return real data); upgrade Combo 1 Synthesis prompt to 5-layer Markdown structure with empty data handling
v3.2.0: Added official openclaw cron add automation examples for 7 combos with conditional alert support.
